caption:
About 7 in every 100 dollars of credit card debt is sliding into serious delinquency. 📊

The New York Fed says 6.97% of card balances moved into 90+ days late in Q2 2026, about flat from last year's 6.93%.

So it's not getting dramatically worse. It's just stuck high.

Do you feel like card debt is getting easier or harder to stay on top of?
first_comment: Be honest: is your card balance higher or lower than a year ago? 👇
